source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether health is present by checking physical, mental, and social well-being, not only by checking for disease.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A disease-free person with persistent mental distress is fully healthy.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The muscular person with an active illness is fully healthy.

intelligence.enrichment: Health is complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. Balanced body, mind, social life, and surroundings support health; loneliness, poor habits, or poor surroundings reduce well-being. The learner correctly applies this rule: Health is complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. A person with no named disease is healthy, even if the person is lonely and cannot sleep well.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Health: reaching the unreached. The student must decide: Decide whether health is present by checking physical, mental, and social well-being, not only by checking for disease. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
